page.title: Trip insurance

form.title: Edit product · {name}

fields.isActiveDescription: When off, customers no longer see this option. Policies already sold are not affected.

help.maxPayoutNote: For example: “Up to the vehicle’s actual value”, “Per person, per incident”.

validation.urlTemplate: The template must start with https:// and contain '{certCode}'.

certificates.defaultViewHint: Showing FAILED policies — the work queue. Switch to "All" to see history.

empty.description: Policies that fail to issue show up here.

certificates.loadError: Could not load the certificate queue.

partnerMissing.title: No insurance partner connected
partnerMissing.body: This environment has no issuing partner, so policies stop in the failed state. Collected premiums are held in custody; retrying will not issue a certificate until a partner is connected.

emptyAll.title: No insurance policies yet
emptyAll.description: Insurance policies for trips will appear here.

drawer.title: Insurance policy
drawer.testNote: TEST certificate issued by the mock adapter — it provides no insurance cover.

footer.failed: Failed policy: retry issuing, or void it if it cannot be issued.
footer.issued: Certificate issued. Void it if the trip is cancelled after handover.
footer.other: No actions are available for this status.

drawer.retryQueued: Queued for re-issue — the worker picks it up within about a minute.

voidDialog.title: Void insurance policy
voidDialog.summary: The {amount} premium for booking {code} will be settled separately with the partner.
voidDialog.hint: The reason is written to the system log and the partner case file.
voidDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Trip cancelled after handover, partner confirmed cancellation
